$comment: The source of sf-quantity's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/quantity (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

name.summary: The form name: a hidden input submits the value with a point and no grouping (`2567.50`), whatever the box shows. The box itself has no name.

label.summary: The field label above the box; it names the spinbutton. Slot `label` takes markup instead.

hint.summary: Help text under the field; slot `hint` takes markup instead.

min.summary: The lower bound: «−» is disabled on it, Home goes to it, a typed value below it is raised to it on commit. Empty for none; with none, or one below zero, a minus sign may be typed.

max.summary: The upper bound: «+» is disabled on it, End goes to it, a typed value above it is lowered to it on commit. Empty for none.

step.summary: How far «−», «+», ArrowUp and ArrowDown move the value. A positive number; anything else is 1. Its decimals are the field's digits unless `precision` says otherwise.

page-step.summary: How far PageUp and PageDown move the value; ten steps when empty.

precision.summary: Digits after the decimal mark, shown and kept; empty takes them from `step` (0.25 has two). With none, a decimal mark cannot be typed.

grouping.summary: Group thousands the page's language's way («2 567»); `grouping="false"` writes the digits together, for a year or a code.

locale.summary: The language the number is read and written in; unset, the page's (`lang`), so the decimal mark is a comma on a Russian page.

size.summary: Field size: 1/2, 1 or 2, as every form field.

required.summary: The field must hold a number: the box is required, so a form will not submit while it is empty.

disabled.summary: Shown and not changed: the box and both steppers are disabled, and the hidden input is not submitted.

readonly.summary: Shown and not changed: the box is read-only, the steppers are disabled, the keys do not step.

invalid.summary: The error state: the edge and the message take the error colour and the box carries aria-invalid.

error-message.summary: The error shown in place of the hint while the field is invalid; slot `error` takes markup instead.

decrement-label.summary: The accessible name of «−». Unset, it follows the page's language («Уменьшить значение», «Decrease value»).

increment-label.summary: The accessible name of «+». Unset, it follows the page's language («Увеличить значение», «Increase value»).

value.summary: The number the field holds, written with a point (`2567.5`); empty for none. The property reads a number or null and takes a number, numeric text or null. Rounded to the field's digits. Set from code it fires nothing.
The number the field now holds; null when it is empty.

text.summary: The number as the field writes it, in the page's language.

source.summary: What made the change: typing in the box, a commit (Enter or leaving the box), a stepper, a key, or the reset back to the inherited value.

change.$comment: Sent on the host as `change` with a detail: once per commit (Enter, leaving the box, a stepper press or a held run, a key) and for a reset to the inherited value (§17.3).
change.summary: The value was committed: once per change the person made -- a commit of typed text (Enter or leaving the box), a stepper press (one for a whole held run), a key, a reset. A CustomEvent on the host; the box's own change does not leave the host. A commit that only rewrites the text fires nothing.

value.summary: The number the field now holds; null when it is empty.

text.summary: The number as the field writes it, in the page's language.

source.summary: What made the change: typing in the box, a commit (Enter or leaving the box), a stepper, a key, or the reset back to the inherited value.

input.$comment: Sent on the host as `input` with a detail each time the number moves; the text box's own input and change stop at the host.
input.summary: The value moved: while typing, each time the text reads as a different number; on each step of a stepper or a key; before every change whose value it has not reported yet. Same detail as change.

field-reset.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. The event of the trait field-inherit@1: one name for every field of the family, so a form hears them all at once and tells them apart by detail.tag. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

tag.summary: The element that was reset, as a tag name.

value.summary: The field's own value before the reset.

inherited-value.summary: The inherited value it returns to.

name.summary: The form name, empty when the field has none.

clear.summary: Empty the field from code; the same as setValue(null). Returns the element.

step-up.summary: Move the value up by `count` steps (1 by default), held by the bounds, as a native field's stepUp(). Fires nothing. Returns the element.

step-down.summary: Move the value down by `count` steps (1 by default), held by the bounds. Fires nothing. Returns the element.

set-error.summary: Show an error message and the invalid state, or clear both with an empty message. Writes error-message and invalid. Returns the element.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-quantity for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the base (§3.1, §4.8); no shim
error is a dated alias of invalid; the shim maps the attribute and the property
rows.summary: The error state; the same as invalid.

rows.note: the event of the trait field-inherit@1, declared in component.json as the shared event field-reset; the field sends sf-field-reset and the shim follows it with this dated name, same detail, one cancel
rows.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. Not prevented, the field empties, says so with input and change (source reset), shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

x-summary: A number field with «−» and «+»: a WAI-ARIA spinbutton with bounds, a step and digits, strict typing in the page's language, ArrowUp/ArrowDown, PageUp/PageDown and Home/End, a held stepper repeats; label, help, error, required, disabled, read-only, the three field sizes and the inherited value as every field has them.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
x-decisions: number-type: page-step and precision are numbers with nullable (no number = the default: ten steps, the step's digits); precision is an integer 0..20, as the code clamps.

trait-words: the field-inherit@1 words stay in lang x-trait-words beside the component words, as the sf-switch pilot keeps them; the running words are helpers/inherited-value.js INHERITED_TEXT until the trait has its own folder (Annex A item 13 is open).

trait field-inherit@1: host state data-inherited (§5.3, §20.2) and the trait event sf-field-reset with sf-field:reset as its dated same-detail alias (aliases.json), as the sf-switch pilot; an inherited value never satisfies required (§20.2).
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift).
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (count 2 of 0..99) plus a price with two digits, a bound reached, invalid with a message, disabled, read-only, inherited and size 2.
css-variables: the nine public variables of public-variables.v1.json plus --sf-quantity-invalid-border-color for the invalid state: ten (§6).
host-states: data-at-min and data-at-max say on the host that the value stands at a bound (§5.3, simai/ui-source#46 item 4), beside the trait's data-inherited.

events: input and change keep their native names and carry a detail {value, text, name, source}; the manifest says carries native (the DOM name) and x-detail (the fields), since a declared carries object would derive sf-quantity-input (§8).

actions: clear, step-up, step-down and the new set-error {message} answer an outcome (§4.4: chaining is not part of the interface; they returned the element). set-error now also sets custom-error, so the form does not submit over it (§17.2; it used to paint only, stand 15 A2).
form.validity: value-missing from the box, range-underflow, range-overflow and step-mismatch read off the value (a person may type past a bound until the commit clamps it), and custom-error.
form: the host submits the number with a point through ElementInternals; the hidden input is not drawn then and the box has no name (§17.1 items 2, 6).
focus: the pointer-focus class is no longer written by the element; the ring follows :focus-visible (§5.3, §16 item 9). The class component's binder still writes it for hand-written markup.
words: decrement and increment are lang runtime words (settings default-from them); range-underflow, range-overflow and step-mismatch are new runtime words for the validity message.
version 1.1.0: set-error and the host states are added members, error is renamed behind a dated alias (§4.10).

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.

version 1.1.2: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.2.0: the trait event is declared in component.json as the shared event field-reset (standard 1.3.13 §8: an event a trait brings is named sf-<verb>, with no tag): the element sends sf-field-reset itself and the manifest describes it, with tag in the detail. Before, the registry described only the retired sf-field:reset and no current name, and the new name came from the alias shim alone. The dated sf-field:reset follows with the same detail and one cancel until 2026-12-01.

$comment: sf-quantity draws the class component's markup, so the class rule comes with
it: the quantity sheet, and through it the icon buttons its steppers are
drawn as. The glyphs are the icon font; the reset back to an inherited value
is an icon button too (simai/ui-source#28). Its own sheet is the inherited

forbidden_client_responsibilities: validation beyond the bounds, the step and the digits

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-quantity for a form value that is a number a person adjusts by steps -- an amount, a count, an integer property -- with bounds and digits.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not use it for a range picked by dragging: that is sf-range-slider
Do not read the box's text as the value: read value (a number or null) or the submitted form value

accessibility.focus: One tab stop: the text box with role spinbutton, named by the label (aria-labelledby) or by aria-label, carrying aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuetext in the page's format, and described by the help or error. ArrowUp/ArrowDown step, PageUp/PageDown move ten steps, Home/End go to the bounds when there are bounds, Enter commits, Escape takes typing back. «−» and «+» are real buttons named «Уменьшить значение» / «Увеличить значение», out of the tab order as the APG pattern has them, controlling the box, disabled at the bounds; a pointer press does not take focus from the box. Pointer focus draws no ring, keyboard focus does.

sf-field:reset.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. Not prevented, the field empties, says so with input and change (source reset), shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

value.description: The field's own value before the reset, written with a point.

inheritedValue.description: The inherited value it returns to.

name.description: The form name, empty when the field has none.

setValue.summary: Set the number from code: a number, numeric text with a point, or null for none. Rounded to the field's digits, not clamped. Fires nothing, as a value set from code is not a change. Returns the element.

resetToInherited.summary: Return the field to its inherited value, as the reset button does: sf-field-reset first (cancellable), then input and change. Returns whether it reset.

getInputElement.summary: Returns the spinbutton's text box, or null before render.

aria-label.description: The spinbutton's accessible name when no label is drawn inside the field: a form that prints the label beside it (the Framework's field renderers) names the field without a second, visible label.

value.description: The number the field holds, written with a point (`2567.5`); empty for none. The property reads a number or null and takes a number, numeric text or null. Rounded to the field's digits. Set from code it fires nothing.

inherited-value.description: What the field falls back to while it holds no number of its own -- a default from a parent setting. Shown in the empty box in the placeholder's ink with an «inherited» marker, never as the value: the form value stays empty. Once the field holds a number of its own, a reset button returns it here.

inherited-text.description: The words of the marker shown while the inherited value applies. Unset, it follows the page's language («inherited», «наследуется»).

reset-label.description: The accessible name of the button that returns the field to the inherited value. Unset, it follows the page's language («Reset to inherited», «Сбросить к наследуемому»).
